name: Discovery Cube Los Angeles Teen Volunteer
what_you_do: Teen volunteers run hands-on science exhibits, help at birthday parties and support special events at the science center. Most shifts are on weekends, school holidays and in summer.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18. If you are 14, you can start the application one month before your 15th birthday.
duration: Minimum 60 hours; two 4-hour shifts every 30 days
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application for a role. The roles are Exhibit Host, Team Spark and Team Celebration. Email a resume and a letter from an adult who is not family. Send them to VolunteerLA@discoverycube.org. Then do an interview and a mandatory orientation.
notes: The museum is in Sylmar in the San Fernando Valley. The letter of recommendation cannot come from a family member. Questions: 818-686-2835.
